instruction: A studio portrait photograph, captured in a close-up shot at eye level. In a minimalist indoor photo studio with a seamless white background, the red-haired woman in the blue shirt (R2) is on the left, leaning her head close to her friend's shoulder and looking directly at the camera with a calm, neutral expression. Beside her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the green crop top (R1) stands close to her friend, looking directly at the camera with a serious, confident expression. The red-haired woman (R2) rests her left hand on the right shoulder of the curly-haired woman (R1) as they pose closely together. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows, creating a clean white and pastel color palette.
